project: Des Moines AI Pulse — iOS Native App
description: iOS Native App Hardening — Comprehensive audit-driven improvements focused on the Capacitor iOS shell (WKWebView). Covers layout overflow bugs, safe area compliance, native-feel interactions (haptics, pull-to-refresh), performance optimizations (image lazy-loading, scroll performance), navigation polish, keyboard handling, accessibility in native context, push notification wiring, deep link support, and App Store readiness.

userStories.title: Fix image overflow breaking page layout on iOS
userStories.description: As a mobile user, I need images to never exceed the viewport width so that the page layout stays intact and all buttons/text remain accessible.
acceptanceCriteria: Global CSS reset: img, video { max-width: 100%; height: auto } in @layer base
html.capacitor-app has overflow-x: hidden (not just body/#root)
Capacitor-specific img max-width: 100% !important safety net
All image containers in cards/detail pages have overflow-hidden
No horizontal scroll on any page when viewing wide event/restaurant images
Build passes (npm run build)
userStories.notes: Root cause: images with intrinsic widths larger than viewport push the entire page wider on iOS WKWebView. Fixed in components: EventCard, EventsNearMe, Index modal. Global CSS catches all others.

userStories.title: Improve BottomNav haptic feedback with Capacitor Haptics
userStories.description: As a mobile user, I want to feel subtle haptic feedback when tapping navigation items so the app feels more native and responsive.
acceptanceCriteria: Import hapticTap from @/lib/capacitorUtils in BottomNav
Call hapticTap() on nav item click instead of navigator.vibrate
Fallback gracefully on web (no-op when Haptics plugin unavailable)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Replaced navigator.vibrate(10) with hapticTap() from capacitorUtils. Much better native haptic feel on iOS.

userStories.title: Add haptic feedback to favorite/like and share actions
userStories.description: As a mobile user, I want haptic feedback when I favorite an event, rate a restaurant, or share content so interactions feel tactile and confirmed.
acceptanceCriteria: Import hapticTap from @/lib/capacitorUtils
Add hapticTap() call to favorite toggle actions across event/restaurant cards
Add hapticTap() call to share button actions
Add hapticTap() call to rating interactions
Fallback gracefully on web
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Added hapticTap() to FavoriteButton (on toggle), ShareDialog (on native share), and RatingSystem (on star click). All gracefully no-op on web.

userStories.title: Fix keyboard push-up behavior on iOS form inputs
userStories.description: As a mobile user, when I tap a search field or form input, the keyboard should push the content up smoothly without obscuring the input field.
acceptanceCriteria: Verify Capacitor Keyboard plugin resize mode is 'native' (already set)
Add scrollIntoView behavior on input focus for search fields
Test on iOS: search bar, auth forms, and trip planner input stay visible above keyboard
No layout jump or content hidden behind keyboard
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Created useKeyboardAware hook that listens for Capacitor Keyboard plugin events (keyboardWillShow/keyboardWillHide) and scrolls focused inputs into view. Falls back to focusin listener with scrollIntoView for environments without the plugin. Added CSS: hides bottom nav when keyboard is visible, adjusts main padding, adds scroll-margin-bottom to focused inputs.

userStories.title: Optimize scroll performance with CSS containment
userStories.description: As a mobile user, I want smooth 60fps scrolling on long event/restaurant list pages without jank or stutter.
acceptanceCriteria: Add CSS contain: layout style paint to card components in list views
Add content-visibility: auto to below-the-fold sections (already have cv-auto class)
Apply will-change: transform to cards that have hover/tap animations
Remove unnecessary box-shadow transitions on mobile (use @media (hover: none))
Scrolling on Events page with 50+ events is smooth on iOS simulator
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Added contain: layout style paint to all cards in Capacitor. Disabled hover shadow/translate transitions on touch-only devices. Prevents layout thrashing during scroll.

userStories.title: Add pull-to-refresh on main list pages
userStories.description: As a mobile user, I want to pull down on the events/restaurants list to refresh the data, matching the standard iOS interaction pattern.
acceptanceCriteria: Create a usePullToRefresh hook that detects pull-down gesture on touch devices
Integrate with TanStack Query's refetch() on events and restaurants pages
Show a subtle loading indicator during refresh (spinner or shimmer)
Only activate on Capacitor/touch devices (not desktop)
Pull-to-refresh triggers haptic feedback via hapticTap()
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: usePullToRefresh hook already existed with touch gesture detection. Added hapticTap() feedback on pull trigger. Added pull-to-refresh to RestaurantsPage (EventsPage already had it). Uses ptr-indicator CSS class for the refresh spinner.

userStories.title: Fix header safe area overlap on notched iPhones
userStories.description: As an iPhone user with a notch/Dynamic Island, the header content should not overlap with the status bar or notch area.
acceptanceCriteria: Header uses env(safe-area-inset-top) consistently across all pages
Content below header is not obscured on iPhone 14 Pro / 15 Pro (Dynamic Island)
Capacitor CSS already adds padding-top via header::before — verify it works for all header variants
No double spacing on non-notched devices
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Fixed double safe area spacing. The header had three overlapping safe-area mechanisms: .safe-area-top class, .capacitor-app header padding-top override, and ::before pseudo-element. Set padding-top to 0 in Capacitor so only the ::before handles it. MobileNav sheet already has safe-area-inset class. viewport-fit=cover is set in index.html.

userStories.title: Implement native-feel page transitions
userStories.description: As a mobile user, I want smooth slide-in/out page transitions when navigating between pages so the app feels native rather than web-like.
acceptanceCriteria: Add CSS-based slide transition for forward navigation (slide left)
Add slide-back transition for back navigation (slide right)
Transitions are 200-300ms (fast enough to feel snappy)
Transitions respect prefers-reduced-motion
Only active in Capacitor context (web stays instant)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Created usePageTransition hook that detects route changes and applies a cap-page-enter CSS class for a subtle slide-fade animation (250ms ease-out). Scoped to .capacitor-app. Respects prefers-reduced-motion via existing CSS rule. Attached via KeyboardShortcutsProvider wrapper div.

userStories.title: Add network status indicator for offline/slow connections
userStories.description: As a mobile user on a spotty connection, I want to see a clear indicator when I'm offline and be able to view cached content.
acceptanceCriteria: OfflineBanner component shows when network is unavailable
Banner is styled for iOS (matches Capacitor theme, uses safe areas)
TanStack Query serves stale cached data when offline
Network recovery triggers automatic refetch of visible queries
Banner dismisses automatically when connection restored
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Enhanced useNetworkStatus hook to use Capacitor Network plugin for reliable detection. Added queryClient.invalidateQueries() on reconnect for auto-refetch. OfflineBanner now respects safe area insets with z-[60] to sit above the header. TanStack Query already uses networkMode: 'always' with gcTime caching.

userStories.title: Optimize hero section for Capacitor (skip Three.js)
userStories.description: As a mobile user, the home page hero should load instantly without the heavy Three.js 3D city model that's designed for desktop.
acceptanceCriteria: EnhancedHero already skips Three.js in mobile builds (IS_NATIVE check) — verify this works
Mobile hero shows a fast static or CSS-animated alternative
Hero height is compact in Capacitor (no min-h-screen)
Quick actions are prominently displayed for fast navigation
LCP (Largest Contentful Paint) under 2s on mobile
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Verified: EnhancedHero sets HeroCityLite = null when __MOBILE_APP__ is true (build-time tree-shaking). CSS .capacitor-app section[class*='min-h-'] forces min-height: auto. QuickActionsMobile renders with large touch targets and gold gradient primary action. No changes needed — all criteria already met.

userStories.title: Wire up push notification registration and event reminders
userStories.description: As a mobile user, I want to receive push notifications for events I've set reminders for so I don't miss them.
acceptanceCriteria: Register for push notifications on app launch (with user permission prompt)
Store device token in Supabase user profile or device_tokens table
EventReminderSettings component triggers local notification scheduling
Notifications show event title, time, and deep link back to event
Handle notification tap to navigate to event detail page
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Created usePushNotifications hook for the main web app that registers with APNs/FCM via Capacitor PushNotifications plugin, stores token in Supabase device_tokens table, handles notification tap navigation. Added scheduleEventReminder() for local notifications. Wired into App.tsx for auto-registration and EventReminderSettings for local notification scheduling.

userStories.title: Implement deep linking for event/restaurant URLs
userStories.description: As a mobile user, when I tap a shared link to an event or restaurant, it should open directly in the app instead of the browser.
acceptanceCriteria: Configure Associated Domains in iOS project (applinks:desmoinespulse.com)
Add apple-app-site-association file to public/.well-known/
Handle incoming deep link URLs in Capacitor App plugin listener
Route /events/:slug and /restaurants/:slug to correct pages
Fallback to web for unmatched URLs
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: apple-app-site-association file already exists with /events/*, /restaurants/*, /attractions/* paths. Created useDeepLinks hook that listens for Capacitor App plugin 'appUrlOpen' events and navigates to the corresponding route. Wired into App.tsx. Associated Domains already configured in iOS project.

userStories.title: Add swipe-back gesture support for navigation
userStories.description: As an iOS user, I want to swipe from the left edge to go back, matching the standard iOS navigation pattern.
acceptanceCriteria: Detect left-edge swipe gesture on detail pages
Trigger React Router back navigation on successful swipe
Only active in Capacitor context
Gesture does not conflict with horizontal scrolling elements (maps, carousels)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Created useSwipeBack hook that detects left-edge swipe gestures (within 30px of screen edge) and triggers React Router navigate(-1). Only active on Capacitor iOS, not on home page. Uses velocity and distance thresholds to avoid false positives. Doesn't conflict with horizontal scrolling elements.

userStories.title: Fix status bar text color on dark hero images
userStories.description: As an iOS user, the status bar text should be white/light when viewing pages with dark hero images (event detail, restaurant detail) so it's readable.
acceptanceCriteria: Use Capacitor StatusBar plugin to set light text on dark-hero pages
Revert to dark text when navigating away from hero pages
Handle scroll: switch to dark text when scrolled past hero image
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Created useStatusBarStyle hook that switches status bar text color on route change. Light text on detail pages with dark heroes (/events/:slug, /restaurants/:slug, etc.) and home page. Dark text on list pages. Uses Capacitor StatusBar plugin setStyle.

userStories.title: Add iOS-native image viewer for event/restaurant photos
userStories.description: As a mobile user, tapping an event/restaurant image should open a full-screen native-feel image viewer with pinch-to-zoom and swipe-to-dismiss.
acceptanceCriteria: Create ImageViewer component with full-screen overlay
Support pinch-to-zoom gesture on iOS
Support swipe-down-to-dismiss gesture
Show image loading state while high-res version loads
Only activate in Capacitor (web uses existing lightbox behavior)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Created ImageViewer component with full-screen overlay, pinch-to-zoom (2-finger gesture using Math.hypot distance), and swipe-down-to-dismiss (opacity fades as user swipes). Only activates in Capacitor. Uses touch-action: none for gesture control. Close button respects safe area insets.

userStories.title: Optimize list rendering with virtualization for long lists
userStories.description: As a mobile user scrolling through 100+ events, the page should remain smooth without memory issues from rendering all cards at once.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement windowed rendering for event/restaurant lists with 50+ items
Use IntersectionObserver-based approach (no heavy library dependency)
Only render cards within viewport + 2 screen heights buffer
Maintain scroll position when navigating back to list
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Created useVirtualList hook — lightweight scroll-based virtualization using requestAnimationFrame for scroll tracking. Only activates when itemCount exceeds threshold (default 50). Returns startIndex/endIndex for slicing, totalHeight/offsetTop for spacer positioning. No external dependencies.

userStories.title: Cache images locally for faster repeat loads
userStories.description: As a mobile user, previously viewed event/restaurant images should load instantly from cache on repeat visits.
acceptanceCriteria: Use service worker or Cache API to cache loaded images
Cache up to 100 most recently viewed images (LRU eviction)
Cached images serve instantly on repeat page visits
Cache persists across app restarts
No impact on first-load performance
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: WKWebView has its own HTTP cache but it may be cleared. A more persistent Cache API or service worker approach ensures images survive app restarts. Consider registering a service worker in main.tsx for Capacitor builds.

userStories.title: Add App Store metadata and screenshot generation
userStories.description: As a developer preparing for App Store submission, I need proper metadata, screenshots, and privacy labels configured.
acceptanceCriteria: Create mobile-app/docs/app-store-metadata.md with title, subtitle, description, keywords
Document required screenshots sizes (6.7", 6.1", 5.5" iPhones, iPad Pro)
Document privacy nutrition labels (data collected, tracking)
List all required App Store Connect fields
Typecheck passes (no code changes, docs only)
userStories.notes: Fastlane is already set up in mobile-app/fastlane/. This story focuses on preparing the content needed before submission.

userStories.title: Fix double-tap zoom on iOS interactive elements
userStories.description: As a mobile user, double-tapping buttons or cards should not trigger the iOS zoom behavior — it should just register as two taps.
acceptanceCriteria: Add touch-action: manipulation to all interactive elements in Capacitor
Buttons, cards, links, and form elements do not trigger double-tap zoom
Pinch-to-zoom still works on images and maps
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Added touch-action: manipulation to all interactive elements (button, a, input, select, textarea, label) scoped to .capacitor-app. Prevents double-tap zoom while preserving pinch-zoom on images/maps.

userStories.title: Add loading skeleton screens for iOS-native feel
userStories.description: As a mobile user, I want to see skeleton placeholder screens while content loads instead of a spinner, matching modern iOS app patterns.
acceptanceCriteria: Create skeleton variants for EventCard, RestaurantCard, and detail page hero
Skeletons match the actual card layout (image placeholder, text lines, badges)
Use the existing skeleton-mobile CSS class
Replace loading spinners with skeletons on main list pages
Skeletons animate with a subtle shimmer (already have loading-shimmer class)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Some skeleton/loading states may already exist. The skeleton-mobile and loading-shimmer CSS classes are in index.css. Focus on the main user-facing pages: events list, restaurants list, detail pages.
